origin.description: A stack backed by a list. The list grows as objects are pushed. mpop shrinks it when less than half is occupied, never below init.

arguments.name: init
arguments.text: Initial and minimum length of the backing list.

arguments.name: missing_default
arguments.text: Value returned by pop() or peek() when the stack is empty. The default is NULL.

origin.details: push and mpush add on top. pop and mpop take from the top; the first element of mpop is the old top. as_list runs from the bottom to the top. An empty mpush stops.
origin.value: A list of functions closing over the stack.
origin.example: s <- faststack(); s$push(5); s$push(6); s$push(7); s$as_list(); s$pop()

translation.details: push and mpush add on top. mpush's _list is R's .list and is pushed after the positional objects. pop and mpop take from the top. as_list runs from the bottom to the top.
translation.value: A FastStack. Call methods with Python syntax.
translation.example:
from fastmap.faststack import faststack
s = faststack()
s.push(5); s.push(6); s.push(7)
print(s.as_list()); print(s.pop())
